evidence: Carries the Validation label and alters ValidationState invariants in src/consensus/validation.h as well as TestBlockValidity logic in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: The PR fixes an unset validation state in TestBlockValidity introduced in PR #31981 and prevents future omissions by enforcing explicit results and reasons with Assumes.
